about: the 'never-ending display list' freeze (2026-10-27): two ported Superstars whose palettes sit right before their display lists -- Jeff Jarrett (0x030B) and Jim Neidhart (0x060E) -- in a singles match, CPU vs CPU. The exe watches each slot's part 1 palette + 0xE0 (WCW_WATCH_MOD): in the frozen Rumble 32 bytes written there ran over Jarrett's display list's end. A write there is in game_stderr.txt with what wrote it

expect.name: no model's matrices ever went bad
